Drastically improved the spawning methods of mobs required for the "Lesser Known Issue" daily. During the day of the daily, mobs whose density is scarce will have increased spawn timer. All mobs pretty much have the same respawn timer. Before this change, because all mobs had a similar spawn timer it basically meant you had to follow in the path of the person who arrived first and that cycle will continue throughout the daily. Now, since scarce mob density area mobs respawn faster this will not only allow for people to cycle in and out faster but will also serve to break up the monotonous path first set by the person who cleared the daily. Additionally, more mobs have been added to a lot of the zones where mob density was lacking superbly.
